text.en: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses in rural areas. It replaced Indira Awaas Yojana from 1 April 2016.

description.quote: PMAY-G aims at providing a pucca house, with basic amenities, to all houseless householder and those households living in kutcha and dilapidated house

text.en: The page states that unit assistance was increased to ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas and IAP districts.

benefits.quote: The unit assistance has been increased from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 1.20 lakh in plain and from Rs75,000 to Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas and IAP district.

text.en: The minimum house size is 25 sq.m, including a hygienic cooking space.

benefits.quote: The minimum size of the house has been increased to 25 sq.mt (from20sq.mt) with a hygienic cooking space.

text.en: The scheme targets houseless households and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.

statement.quote: PMAY-G aims at providing a pucca house, with basic amenities, to all houseless householder and those households living in kutcha and dilapidated house

text.en: The official self-check first asks whether you: have no shelter; are destitute/living on alms; are a manual scavenger; belong to a Primitive Tribal Group; or are a legally released bonded labourer.

statement.quote: Q1. Do you meet any of the following conditions? You: a. do not have a shelter b. are destitute/ living on alms c. are a manual scavenger d. are part of a Primitive Tribal Group e. are a legally released bonded labourer
